SUMMARY
Perfect for commuters, this beautifully presented first-floor flat on Leeds Road (BD1) sits just outside Bradford city centre near excellent public transport links. The turn-key property features one bedroom, a fitted kitchen, and a modern bathroom.

DESCRIPTION
Located on the vibrant Leeds Road (BD1), this beautifully presented first-floor flat offers the perfect balance of edge-of-city convenience and modern comfort. Just a short walk from Bradford city centre, the property boasts exceptional access to local bus routes and public transport links, and only a five minute walk to both train stations, making it an ideal choice for first-time buyers or commuting professionals. Inside, the flat features a bright, well-proportioned bedroom, a modern fitted kitchen ready for immediate use, and a clean, contemporary bathroom. Maintained to a high standard throughout, fully furnished (if needed) this charming home is completely turn-key and ready for its next owner to move straight in.

Hallway 
With access to front entrance door.

Lounge 14' 2" x 7' 8" ( 4.32m x 2.34m )
With window to the side. Open plan living into the kitchen.

Kitchen 12' 4" x 5' 5" ( 3.76m x 1.65m )
Fully fitted kitchen with a range of wall and base units. With open plan living into the lounge.

Bedroom 16' 9" x 8' 5" ( 5.11m x 2.57m )
With window to the side.

Bathroom 
Fitted bathroom comprising of a panel bath, wash hand basin and W/C.
